source_contract.causal_vertex: Bianchi-Chen-Gamonal arXiv:2601.23162 Eq. (4) defines the fixed-causal vertex as the product of ten Toller matrices followed by four SL(2,C) integrations after g_1=1 gauge fixing.
source_contract.wedge_iepsilon: Eq. (3) defines each Toller matrix by an individual spectral Feynman i-epsilon boundary-value limit epsilon->0+.
source_contract.coherent_distribution: Eq. (17) and Appendix D, Eqs. (D1)-(D3), rewrite each Toller block with Theta=theta(sigma B)+sigma*delta^(rho,j)(B), where delta^(rho,j) is a finite sum of derivatives of Dirac delta supported at B=0.
source_contract.B_map: Eq. (C7): B(z,g)=log(<g^dagger z|g^dagger z>/<z|z>). At g=1, B(z,1)=0 for every nonzero spinor z. For an infinitesimal Hermitian boost v.sigma/2, dB=n_z.dv with n_z the spinor Bloch unit vector, up to an irrelevant common normalization/sign convention.
source_contract.distribution_product_scope: A standard sufficient transversality condition for the product/pullback of delta constraints is full row rank of the joint constraint differential on common support. Failure of that sufficient condition is a mathematical-definition gap, not by itself a proof that no extension/renormalized product exists.
source_contract.vertex_limit_scope: The displayed fixed-causal vertex Eq. (4) multiplies already-defined Toller blocks; no joint ten-wedge epsilon limiting prescription is part of Eq. (4) itself.
